description: Use this when you need DNS, registration, TLS, email, phone or IP facts about a contact. Self-hosted on BitTuitive hardware (no upstream). Pass domain, email, phone and/or ip, or a single q to auto-detect. Returns DNS (A/AAAA/MX/TXT including SPF and DMARC), RDAP registration (created, expiry, registrar, age in days), TLS certificate validity, email syntax plus MX and a disposable-domain flag, phone validity/type/region, and IP geolocation plus ASN. Mailboxes are never probed over SMTP. Priced at $0.001 USDC plus the BitTuitive fee max(20%, 3 sats) (typically about 4-5 sats or about $0.004). Unpaid calls return an L402 invoice and an x402 quote. Pay by calling without a credential, paying the Lightning invoice or the USDC amount, then retrying with l402_credential='<macaroon>:<preimage>' or x402_payment. One payment buys one response. Or prepay at /api/v1/credits (Bearer btf_ token) or add ?bt_pass=1 for a 5-minute pass. Details: https://api.bittuitive.ai/pay. Example: check_domain(domain="example.com") Informational only; not financial, investment, legal or tax advice; provided as-is, with no warranty; verify before acting. https://api.bittuitive.ai/disclaimer.

credit.description: 24h credit token from an earlier failed check_domain call.

credit_token.description: Prepaid btf_ token (or pass Authorization elsewhere).

domain.description: A public domain name, for example example.com.

email.description: An email address. Syntax, MX and disposable-domain are checked; SMTP is never used.

ip.description: A public IPv4 or IPv6 address.

l402_credential.description: L402 credential '<macaroon>:<preimage_hex>' from a paid invoice (or an active subscription). Omit it on the first call to receive the Lightning invoice and macaroon.

phone.description: A phone number, ideally in +E.164 form.

phone_region.description: Optional 2-letter region if the phone number is not in +E.164 form.

q.description: A single value; it is detected as a domain, email, phone or IP.

x402_payment.description: x402 payment (USDC on Base): base64 PaymentPayload signed for accepts[0] of the payment_required result. Alternative to l402_credential; also accepted in params._meta['x402/payment'].
